paragraphs: More people are using AI chatbots, such as ChatGPT and DeepSeek, as personal therapists.

These tools provide emotional support and a sense of companionship, particularly for people in remote areas or those who cannot afford traditional therapy. AI can listen, respond with empathy, and personalize answers based on user behavior. Experts like Ronnie Das say AI can now copy human emotions and provide helpful responses for mental well-being.

However, there are concerns. AI doesn’t truly understand emotions or care about people like human therapists do. Dr. Sara Quinn from the Australian Psychological Society warns that AI only imitates conversations and cannot recognize deep emotional needs or dangerous situations. She believes therapy needs privacy rules and careful integration of AI tools.
Even so, AI can help those who would otherwise suffer without support. For many, therapy is too expensive, and AI fills that gap. Experts agree AI’s role in mental health will continue to grow.

paragraphs: Some people use AI chatbots like ChatGPT as personal therapists.

They talk to the bots when they feel sad or need someone to listen. The bots can give advice, help people feel better, and are free to use. AI learns from the way people talk and gives answers that feel personal. It is also useful for people who live far from cities.

But using AI brings problems because it cannot feel real emotions. It also doesn’t understand when someone needs serious help. A therapist is better for deep problems. Dr Quinn says AI is not the same as talking to a real person because AI cannot fully understand complex feelings.
Even with problems, AI can help people who don’t have money for a therapist or don’t live in cities. Experts say AI in mental health will grow in the future.

an opinion that someone offers you about what you should do

paragraphs: Many people talk to AI chatbots. The chatbots help when people feel sad.

But the chatbot is not a real person. It does not feel or think. Some people need more help than a chatbot can give. A therapist is still very important. One doctor says we must use AI carefully.
Still, AI helps people with no one to talk to. Some people do not have money for a therapist or live far from one. Experts believe that more people will use chatbots in the future.
